content.value_statement: Short-drama comments make audience concerns difficult to compare and verify. This skill organizes bounded Hongguo comment samples into evidence-backed themes and follow-up questions.
actual_capabilities: Locate dramas from titles, share links, share text, or series identifiers through documented CLI or configured MCP tools.
Retrieve bounded series-level comment samples, deduplicate by comment identifier, and record coverage.
Group observed feedback into themes with short quotations and comment identifiers.
Retrieve one page of replies for one central dispute when additional context is necessary.
Compare one to three dramas using matching retrieval limits and explicit actual sample sizes.
Retain partial results and resume pagination within the original retrieval limits.
limitations: Online retrieval depends on SocialDataX access, authentication, available credits, and a working CLI environment or configured MCP connection.
The default sample is at most two pages and twenty main comments per drama, not a representative audience survey.
The workflow does not download videos, transcribe episodes, or verify plot claims through viewing.
Comment samples cannot establish completion rates, payment conversion, official rankings, or market popularity trends.

use_cases.title: Investigate Story Concerns
use_cases.description: Identify recurring pacing or ending concerns and connect each concern to quoted comments and verification questions.

use_cases.title: Compare Release Feedback
use_cases.description: Compare audience themes across up to three selected dramas using consistent sampling limits and separate coverage notes.

use_cases.title: Review Character Reactions
use_cases.description: Summarize character and actor feedback while distinguishing audience opinions from verified story facts.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Drama
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Hongguo drama: [share link]. Use default sampling limits and report themes, short quotations, comment identifiers, and sample limitations.

prompt_templates.title: Find and Review a Title
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Hongguo drama titled [title]. Ask me to resolve ambiguous matches before retrieving comments. Summarize character feedback with traceable evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: title resolution and focused feedback

prompt_templates.title: Compare Three Dramas
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these dramas: [three links or identifiers]. Apply identical sampling limits, report actual coverage separately, and propose at most three evidence-backed follow-up questions.

prompt_templates.title: Resume and Investigate a Dispute
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [series identifier] using this saved continuation token: [token]. Preserve prior samples and remaining limits. Inspect one reply page for [comment identifier] only if needed.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: partial-result recovery and targeted context

output_examples.input: Show the report structure for a single drama without retrieving live data.
output: Illustrative structure only; no audience findings are asserted.
Sample scope: drama identity, source, observation time, page coverage, deduplicated main comments, replies, and unfinished retrieval.
Theme evidence: observed theme, feedback direction, short quotation, and comment identifier.
Follow-up: at most three questions grounded in the retrieved evidence.

output_examples.input: No comments were returned for the selected drama. What can the report conclude?
output_examples.output: No comments were available in the retrieved result. Audience themes cannot be established. Confirm the selected drama and report the retrieval scope before drawing conclusions.

output_examples.input: Illustrative scenario: retrieval stopped after partial results, with no continuation token.
output_examples.output: Retain the available comments and error details. Mark coverage as incomplete. Do not restart from the first page automatically or claim full retrieval.

best_practices: Confirm drama identity before retrieval, especially when titles have multiple matches.
Record observation time, actual coverage, deduplication counts, and comment identifiers alongside every conclusion.
Review and pin the external CLI package before execution; keep API credentials in supported secret storage rather than chat or logs.
anti_patterns: Treating sampled comment sentiment as a platform-wide audience approval rate.
Presenting audience plot descriptions as verified facts or claiming personal viewing.
Expanding retrieval, restarting partial requests, or increasing comparison scope without preserving limits and user intent.

faq.question: What input can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Hongguo title, share link, share text, or series identifier. Ambiguous title matches require confirmation.

faq.question: How many comments are reviewed by default?
faq.answer: Each drama uses at most two pages and twenty main comments. Replies are excluded unless one central dispute needs limited context.

faq.question: Does the skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Direct CLI access requires the configured SocialDataX credential. An authenticated hosted MCP connection does not require a separate local CLI key.

faq.question: Can it compare several dramas?
faq.answer: Yes. The default workflow covers one to three selected dramas with matching sampling limits and separately reported actual coverage.

faq.question: Does it post comments or access my Hongguo account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow retrieves data through SocialDataX. It does not log into Hongguo, post comments, contact users, or modify accounts.

faq.question: What should I check before running the CLI?
faq.answer: The examples use npx with an unpinned latest package. Review and pin the package, approve downloads, and protect inherited credentials.
